visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with styled blonde/brown hair and a beige top stands in a busy urban plaza in front of a massive @cosme flagship store featuring pink digital ads. Pedestrians in coats and casual wear walk through the background under bright daylight. (2) Close-up macro shots of hands squeezing essence from a white sheet mask into a clear glass bowl, showcasing the liquid texture. (3) The main character is seen indoors in a room with shelves of luxury handbags; she applies a white sheet mask to her face with white hair clips visible. (4) Detailed product shots of the light blue LuLuLun Hydra-AZ packaging lying on a white surface. (5) Split-screen comparison of the character's facial skin texture before and after treatment, followed by a hand holding a pink digital moisture meter showing numerical changes. (6) Quick cuts of a retail store interior with yellow price tags and the Don Quijote blue penguin mascot, followed by the character back in her room holding the product.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video shifts between the bustling urban exterior of @cosme Tokyo, a well-lit indoor home/studio with shelves for designer bags, and the cluttered, colorful interior of a Japanese pharmacy or Don Quijote store.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female Mandarin narration begins with a bright, enthusiastic pitch. An upbeat, steady 124 BPM electronic-pop BGM with a strong kick-drum foundation runs continuously. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a scene change to liquid essence being squeezed, accompanied by clear, crisp splashing and dripping sound effects. (3) The narration maintains a fast, descriptive pace. High-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' SFX are strategically placed to emphasize skin benefits like hydration and pore care. (4) A mechanical 'click' and digital 'beep' are heard from a moisture meter, followed by a slight swell in BGM volume as the results are announced with high vocal arousal. (5) The speaker delivers a final call-to-action with a confident, friendly tone as the music resolves with a short synthesizer flourish into studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and recommend the LuLuLun Hydra-AZ face mask by demonstrating its efficacy, showing popularity in Japan, and providing quantitative skin hydration results.
